headline: Boosie Speaks on DJ Vlad: Akademiks Shares Exclusive Interview
body: DJ Akademiks shared an Instagram post on September 4, 2026, featuring Boosie discussing his recent comments about DJ Vlad. The post, which garnered 2,599 likes and 576 comments, focuses on Boosie's perspective following recent tensions between the two artists. Akademiks' post highlights the ongoing cultural dialogue within hip-hop circles about artist rivalries and collaborations.
